newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P puts SBC Warburg Australia on CreditWatch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P puts SBC Warburg Australia on CreditWatch.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it has placed the AA long term counterparty ratings of SBC Warburg Australia Holdings Ltd, and its wholly owned subsidiary, SBC Warburg Australia Ltd on CreditWatch with positive implications.
S&P said the move followed the announcement by Swiss Bank Corp SBVZN.S of its intention to move to 100 percent ownership of the SBC Warburg Australia group.

The group's senior unsecured debt obligations under its US$1.5 billion medium-note programme, rated AA, and subordinated debt obligations able to be issued under the smae programme, rated AA minus, were also placed on positive CreditWatch.
The short-term counterparty ratings and their commercial paper programmes were unaffected by the CreditWatch action and were affirmed.
Details concerning the terms and nature of the proposal are not yet known and will be subject to the necessary regulatory approvals being obtained.
S&P said the CreditWatch will be resolved pending further clarification of these details and regulatory approvals.
Swiss Bank Corp currently owns 50.1 percent of SBC Warburg Austalia with 49.9 percent owned by the management group of SBC Warburg Australia
The AA plus/A1 plus counterparty ratings of SBC (Sydney) Ltd, wholly own subsidiary of Swiss Bank Corp, are affirmed.
